  variables:
    - rcvtime_intg:
        comment: 1st column
        coverage_content_type: referenceInformation
        long_name: Integer portion of time, in seconds past 12:00:00 noon of January 1, 2000 in Receiver Time
        units: seconds
    - rcvtime_frac:
        comment: 2nd column
        coverage_content_type: referenceInformation
        long_name: Fractional portion of time tag, in microseconds
        units: microseconds
        valid_range: 0,999999
    - GRACEFO_id:
        comment: 3rd column
        coverage_content_type: referenceInformation
        long_name: GRACE-FO satellite identifier
        units: char
        valid_range: C,D
        value_meanings:
          - C = GRACE-FO 1 (GRACE C)
          - D = GRACE-FO 2 (GRACE D)
    - prn_id:
        comment: 4th column
        coverage_content_type: referenceInformation
        long_name: GPS satellite PRN number
    - ant_id:
        comment: 5th column
        coverage_content_type: referenceInformation
        long_name: GPS or KBR antenna ID
        value_meanings:
          - 0 = GPS navigation antenna
          - 2 = GPS occultation antenna
          - 4 = GPS backup navigation antenna
          - 9 or 11 = KBR antenna
          - -11 = Missed interrupt detected in Ka band phase
    - prod_flag:
        comment: 6th column
        coverage_content_type: referenceInformation
        flag_masks: 1b, 2b, 4b, 8b, 16b, 32b, 64b, 128b, 256b, 512b, 1024b, 2048b, 4096b, 8192b, 16384b, 32768b, 65536b
        flag_meanings:
          - bit 0 = C/A pseudorange
          - bit 1 = L1 pseudorange
          - bit 2 = L2 pseudorange
          - bit 3 = C/A carrier phase
          - bit 4 = L1 carrier phase
          - bit 5 = L2 carrier phase
          - bit 6 = SNR of C/A channel
          - bit 7 = SNR of L1 channel
          - bit 8 = SNR of L2 channel
          - bit 9 = C/A receiver channel
          - bit 10 = L1 receiver channel
          - bit 11 = L2 receiver channel
          - bit 12 = Raw L2 carrier phase
          - bit 13 = Ka band carrier phase
          - bit 14 = SNR of K band
          - bit 15 = SNR of Ka band
        long_name: Product flag, if bit set to 1, value is present in record, bit 0 is rightmost
    - qualflg:
        comment: 7th column
        coverage_content_type: qualityInformation
        flag_masks: 1b, 2b, 4b, 8b, 16b, 32b, 64b, 128b
        flag_meanings:
          - bit 0 = Phase break occurred in L1, C/A, or K band phase
          - bit 1 = Phase break occurred in L2 or Ka band phase
          - bit 2 = Cycle slip detected in L1, C/A, or K band phase
          - bit 3 = Cycle slip detected in L2 or Ka band phase
          - bit 4 = SNR of L1 is < 5
          - bit 5 = SNR of L2 is < 5
          - bit 6 = SNR of K band < 450
          - bit 7 = SNR of Ka band is < 450
        long_name: Quality flag, bit 0 is rightmost
    - CA_range:
        comment: next column, if prod_flag bit set
        coverage_content_type: physicalMeasurement
        long_name: C/A pseudorange
        units: m
    - L1_range:
        comment: next column, if prod_flag bit set
        coverage_content_type: physicalMeasurement
        long_name: L1 pseudorange
        units: m
    - L2_range:
        comment: next column, if prod_flag bit set
        coverage_content_type: physicalMeasurement
        long_name: L2 pseudorange
        units: m
    - CA_phase:
        comment: next column, if prod_flag bit set
        coverage_content_type: physicalMeasurement
        long_name: C/A carrier phase
        units: m
    - L1_phase:
        comment: next column, if prod_flag bit set
        coverage_content_type: physicalMeasurement
        long_name: L1 carrier phase
        units: m
    - L2_phase:
        comment: next column, if prod_flag bit set
        coverage_content_type: physicalMeasurement
        long_name: L2 ion-smoothed carrier phase
        units: m
    - CA_SNR:
        comment: next column, if prod_flag bit set
        coverage_content_type: physicalMeasurement
        long_name: SNR of C/A channel (units + integration time)
        units: V/V
    - L1_SNR:
        comment: next column, if prod_flag bit set
        coverage_content_type: physicalMeasurement
        long_name: SNR of L1 channel
        units: V/V
    - L2_SNR:
        comment: next column, if prod_flag bit set
        coverage_content_type: physicalMeasurement
        long_name: SNR of L2  channel
        units: V/V
    - CA_chan:
        comment: next column, if prod_flag bit set
        coverage_content_type: referenceInformation
        long_name: C/A receiver channel
    - L1_chan:
        comment: next column, if prod_flag bit set
        coverage_content_type: referenceInformation
        long_name: L1 receiver channel
    - L2_chan:
        comment: next column, if prod_flag bit set
        coverage_content_type: referenceInformation
        long_name: L2 receiver channel
    - L2_raw:
        comment: next column, if prod_flag bit set
        coverage_content_type: physicalMeasurement
        long_name: Raw L2 carrier phase
        units: m
    - Ka_phase:
        comment: next column, if prod_flag bit set
        coverage_content_type: physicalMeasurement
        long_name: Ka band carrier phase
        units: cycles
    - K_SNR:
        comment: next column, if prod_flag bit set
        coverage_content_type: physicalMeasurement
        long_name: SNR K band channel
        units: V/V
    - Ka_SNR:
        comment: next column, if prod_flag bit set
        coverage_content_type: physicalMeasurement
        long_name: SNR Ka band channel
        units: V/V
